I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is for **382 seats**. Tobias posted that figure in that channel on Oct 14.

- **Who could see it:** Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he could already see Tobias's message. A seat count also isn't a finance figure, so sharing it there is fine.
- **Later changes:** I read the full channel history, and nobody has posted a different number since Oct 14.
- **gbrain didn't work:** gbrain refused my search because its access hasn't been tied to a member yet, so it returned nothing. I couldn't check whether the contract or account notes say something else. I told Hollis that and suggested he confirm with Tobias before locking the number in.

Fixing gbrain needs whoever runs its server to run `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`.
